content: Mato hanijanoxon sca tah hen hahan pehocohti joi yohirihbixonma hahan haniti Criston joi sca mato nincamacatsihqui. Non nincamenoti joi man honanscai quen tah hen jaa joi mato hahquirihbi yohiti queenyamahi. Jaa joi tah man honanscai: Papa noquehon jenimanon hihquish non quesahi hihrespahoni tah non jenebahinscatihi, Papa nincacoinxon.

Nashimati joibo, mamanjaxon tee hinanti joibo, jenquetsahax mahuanihbo hueniyaxihqui joibo, Papan jascabijaquin casticanyaxihqui joibo. Jaa joibo man honanscai quen hahan haniti joibo sca hen mato yohinon.
Papa queenaiya tah hen jascatihi.
Hinamehnixon bi noquen Hihbo jenebahinscaibo tah non jenquetsahaxon bi jato hahquirihbi hinamehmatimahi. Jaa copi tah hen mato hahquirihbi hinamehti yohicatsihyamahi.
Non jenimanon ta siri joibo Papan yohihiqui. Jayaxihqui coshi ta noque hinanihqui jaya non jihuenon.
Jascajaquin noque hahxonah bi tah non jenebahini bahimahhuan cahax jenquetsahax bi hahquirihbi hinamehtimascai. Papan jisi ta jascapahbaan jahuen baque hosanxon hahquirihbi jihuin hueonaibo qui.
Noquen jointi ta huai quescapah qui. Bexon hoin mehchajaha ta bana siribo joconihqui, huai hihbaan piti siri bihnon. Jascapa huai ta Papan hicha bimijahiqui.
Moxaya mohue boncohi huai ta tiroma qui, casticanti res pishini. Jascapa tah non mapojahi, jan jabiyahpa queyonon.
Hahan teneti shinan
Jascari yohuanxon bi tah hen jascapahboma mato honanai, hea huetsabaan. Papan mato jihuemayaxihqui tah hen mato honanai.
Jatohon shinanxon tah man Papan joiya cahibo yanapanniqui. Nincacoinaibo tah man sirijaquin hahxonpahonixon rahma caman jato hahxonai. Jaa ta Papan shinanbehnotimahiqui.
Jascajaxonti hihti queennahue. Jatihibi man jascanon tah hen queenai. Mahuanoxon caman jato hahxonti hihti queenxon hahxoncoinquin man Papa qui hinamehtai jismanahue.

Jascajati shinan jaax tah man pabebo hihtimascai. Jan yohini quescajaquin ta Papan noque hahxoncointihiqui hihxon jaa honan jeneyamahibo ta Papan jihuetahbo sca qui. Jan yohini quescabijaquin ta jato hahxonihqui.
Abraham hahxonti yohiquin ta tsoa quenati yamahiya jahuen yorayabi Papa yohuannishqui.
Hihcoini. Mia tah hen hihti hahxontihi. Mia tah hen hihti caijatihi, hahquin.
Jaa honanyaxon tene sca Abrahanen jaiya ta Papan jaa hahxoncoinnishqui.

Non hihcoin yohuanain honanahbo hihxon tah non hashoan coshi joni quenanica qui, non hihcoinyamahiya noque mahuamanon. Joni huetsa betan join bahchinanxon tah non jascapa quenaxon coshi joi tantimahi. Sinacananyamascanon.

Jascajaquin rihbi ta Papan yohinishqui. Jahuen jihuetahbo jahuen jihue janin jihueti catihi ta yohicoinnishqui. Jahuentianbi jan shinan huetsajatimatihi non hihti honannon hihxon ta jahuen yorayabixon jato yohinishqui.

Yohuani ta Papa jahuentianbi quesatimahiqui. Quesayosmaxon ta rabejaquin yohicoinnishqui. Jahuentianbi huetsatima joi rabe nincaxon, hahqui hinamehtax jahuen baqueboscaxon non sirijaquin shinanxon jahuen joi bihnon hihxon ta jascajanishqui.
Jaa joi copi tah non hihti honanax jaa honanya jihuetai, jahuatohonbi noque boti hahtipahyamascaquin. Jano Papa Dios jai janin tah non hihcoti hahtipahscai, Papa yocanoxon.
Jano cahi ta Jesus bebonishqui, Melquisedec janí quescapa yohuanxonnicah tah qui, jascabi sca noquen yohuanxonnicah.
